no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Stryker is a medical device company (orthopedic implants, surgical equipment, neurotechnology). It has no proprietary drug pipeline. All clinical studies on ClinicalTrials.gov are either (a) device evaluations of already-marketed products, (b) legacy programs from divested Stryker Biotech (BMP-7/OP-1), or (c) investigator-initiated studies using Stryker devices. No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 drug development.
